==Descriptions==
'''Pumpkin Patch''' is a map that was originally intended to release with the [[Halloween 2019 Event]], but this never happened due to unknown reasons. However, it could be possible this was made before the mega update.As the mega update was made before the Halloween 2019 event which caused this to be scrapped and replaced with the one we know of today.

==Design & Path==
'''Pumpkin Patch''' is set on a few cliffs. On these cliffs, there are various pumpkins, dead trees and tents. These cliffs are connected to each other with wooden bridges, allowing for easy access between them. Some of the cliffs have have fences around the edges. Trucks carrying pumpkins can be seen parked on them.

The path starts at the tent and ends at a cave. It goes through the center of each cliff, using the bridges to go from one to another.
